title: Can’t sync with Health app
body:
Sync between iPhone’s and Samsung’s Health apps does not work.

Actually, Samsung can get fitness data from the Health app, but Health app does not import data from Samsung’s app (can’t or doesn’t want not sure).

Obviously these two parties does not cooperate for the benefit of their users.

UPDATE: Thanks for the feedback, here is mine — you do not have to make Samsung’s Health app work/compatible with every other app on the iPhone; make it to work just with iPhone’s Health app (in both directions) which collects fitness data from all other apps and serves as a hub.

title: Suggestions
body:
Application shows summary information data (per month, week or day) for running, but it counts only full kilometers, not full distance. For instance, two running sessions, 7,60km and 7,80km are count in summary as 14,00km , instead of 15,30km.

Another question is if you can show data in summary area based on distance covered? Currently data on graph can be shown only with time spent on training sessions, but it woud be better if end users can choose in application what is most important to be shown as a summary: distance covered, time spent, or something else.

In addition, I didn’t succeed to send error report via application itself because it crashes or reports an error each time.

Each time when I try to send error report I receive message “Error occurred” in grey box on the bottom of a screen. When I try to attach image in error report application crashes immediately. It is not an network error, it is repeatable behaviour that completely disrupt error report sending functionality.
